title: orobanche multicaulis var. genuina
intro: Orobanche multicaulis var. genuina, commonly known as the "Two-rooted Broomrape", is a parasitic plant species belonging to the Orobanchaceae family. It is known to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can aid in the treatment of various diseases. The therapeutic actions of Orobanche multicaulis var. genuina include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and exhibit sedative effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, phenolic compounds, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy.
